subject: Post-call: alignment & mini-sprint plan for Novum Analytics POC
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam@novum.ai>, Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@novumanalytics.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed mini-sprint for Novum POC

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from my side and a proposed 2-week mini-sprint to validate the integration points we discussed. Please review and confirm owners/timing.

Key pain points you shared:
- High false-positive rate in entity extraction from customer support transcripts (current pipeline ~18% FPR)
- Latency and cost concerns for near-real-time summarization in the customer dashboard (target <300ms per request)
- Lack of prompt/eval pipeline to measure drift across model updates

Goals for the POC:
1) Reduce entity extraction false positives by 30% on a representative prompt set
2) Demonstrate a streaming summarization workflow with median latency <300ms in our dedicated config
3) Deliver an eval harness (prompt set + automated regression checks) you can run against new model versions

Proposed mini-sprint (2 weeks) — deliverables:
- Week 1: Access & infra (API keys, VPC peering checklist), baseline evals on sample data, prompt matrix draft
- Week 2: Model tuning and quantization profile suggestions, latency tuning (batching/cache config), final eval report with metrics and next-step recommendations

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood PM: Irene Choi (overall contact & success criteria)
- Redwood Solutions/Eng: Jordan Blake (integration + latency tuning)
- Redwood Partner/CS: Marissa Cole (onboarding and eval support)
- Novum Technical Lead: Liam Carter (data/sample access)

Immediate asks from Novum to proceed:
1) Sample dataset: 1k anonymized support transcripts (s3 link or upload)
2) Contact for infra (networking/VPC): person who can approve VPC peering and IAM access
3) Confirmation that the eval metric of interest is FPR on entity extraction and 95th percentile latency for summarization

Attachments: I attached a short mutual action spreadsheet with milestones and an access checklist.

Next steps: If this looks right I’ll schedule a 30-min technical alignment with Jordan and your network engineer on Thursday.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

---
Sent from my laptop
From: Liam Carter <liam@novum.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@novumanalytics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed mini-sprint for Novum POC

Thanks Irene — this is great and aligns with our expectations. A few clarifications and items on our side: 

1) Data: we can provide ~1.2k anonymized transcripts. I’ll share an s3 presigned link by EOD Thursday.
2) Network: our infra owner is Aisha (cc’d). She’ll need the VPC peering checklist you mentioned and a list of required CIDR ranges/IPs.
3) Latency targets: 300ms median is fine; for the POC we’d like to capture tail latency (95th/99th) as well so we can understand consistency.

One ask: can you include a lightweight A/B script so we can compare Redwood’s tuned config vs our current deployed pipeline on the same prompt/eval set? That will make success criteria explicit for my PM.

I’m available for the technical alignment on Thursday after 10am PT.

Best,
Liam
Liam Carter
Head of ML Engineering, Novum Analytics
liam@novum.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Liam Carter <liam@novum.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@novumanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed mini-sprint for Novum POC

Looping in the engineering plan and the specific access steps so Aisha can start coordinating with her infra team.

Quick notes from my side:
- Access checklist (high level):
  - Create a service account for Redwood with a least-privilege IAM role (s3 read for bucket, CloudWatch logs access for debug)
  - If VPC peering is preferred, we'll need the VPC ID and one test EC2/Bastion host for initial troubleshooting; otherwise temporary presigned s3 transfer works
  - API key rotation plan: we can use a short-lived key for the POC and hand off a rotation script

- Eval harness plan:
  - We’ll build a small pytest-style suite that runs the prompt set and outputs per-prompt metrics (FPR, precision, recall) and latency percentiles (50/95/99).
  - The A/B script Liam requested: simple runner that calls both Redwood endpoint (tuned config) and Novum’s current endpoint, producing a side-by-side CSV for the PM.

- Mini-sprint timeline (concrete):
  - Thu 25 Mar: tech alignment call (30m) — confirm VPC path and owner
  - Fri 26 Mar: we receive data link + temporary creds
  - Mon 29 Mar: baseline evals complete, initial prompt matrix
  - Fri 2 Apr: tuned config + latency tuning, deliver final eval report

I’ve attached the access instructions PDF and will drop the A/B runner template into the Drive folder.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam@novum.ai>, Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@novumanalytics.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed mini-sprint for Novum POC

Perfect — thanks both. Confirming the tech alignment call for Thu 25 Mar at 11:00am PT (invite sent). Agenda: 1) VPC vs presigned s3 path decision, 2) data handoff steps, 3) owners and first checkpoints.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Novum (Liam): share presigned s3 link or confirm VPC ID by Fri 26 Mar (DUE: 2027-03-26)
- Novum (Aisha): confirm network contact and approve peering checklist before Thu call (DUE: 2027-03-25)
- Redwood (Jordan): drop A/B runner template and access_instructions.pdf in Drive by Thu EOD (DUE: 2027-03-25)
- Redwood (Irene): finalize mutual action plan and send updated sheet after Thu call (DUE: 2027-03-26)

If anything changes, flag in this thread. Looking forward to the call.

Thanks,
Irene

Attachments referenced:
- novum_poc_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (milestones + success criteria)
- redwood_access_instructions.pdf (network & IAM checklist, sample presigned-s3 instructions)
